method: Measured from WS client inside FastAPI container (same clock)

stream_1s.notes: Single 1s interval; ~50ms poll loop, ~1s push when candle changes

key_finding: Thesis claim 'Push Interval p95=52.8ms' is WRONG metric. Actual push interval is ~1s (only on candle change). Actual one-way latency from server to client is p95=1.46ms (internal). External (via internet) estimated at 27-72ms including TLS and internet latency.

thesis_discrepancy.issue: Thesis measured 'poll loop interval' (asyncio.sleep(0.05)) not 'push interval' or 'one-way latency'
